sections.executive_summary: Lebanese army continues unexploded ordnance detonation operations in multiple villages including Mifdoun and Tayr Dabaa following cross-border tensions. The IDF confirmed airstrikes in Gaza killing a Hamas commander and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative. The Saudi coalition reported Houthi attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid airport this month.

points: Iranian cleric Yaser Taheri, imam of the Imam Hasan Askari Mosque in Sari, was killed at his home in Mazandaran Province. Initial reports from IRGC-owned Tasnim indicate a bladed weapon was used. Motive remains unclear. (Source: @shin_persian/11155)
A test launch of a previous missile occurred from Mianeh in East Azerbaijan Province, Iran at 1214Z. The launch was reported with a 120-second delay through FromIran. (Source: @shin_persian/11163)

Operation Economic Outcast targets Iran's international shadow-banking architecture, foreign-currency access, and oil-revenue repatriation channels. OFAC designated an Iraqi bank, Iranian offshore banks, exchange houses, front companies, and 16 individuals. (Source: @shin_persian/11158)

The IDF confirmed airstrikes in Gaza killing Hamas commander Mohammed Mohammed Abd al-Khalek Hala, identified as participating in the October 7 onslaught and involved in weapons production. A separate strike in Khan Younis killed Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative Ahmad Jabrin Tawfiq Dalha. (Source: @manniefabian/59360)

A car-ramming incident was reported near the West Bank settlement of Ateret. At least one person was injured. Troops were dispatched to search for the fleeing driver. Details are under review. (Source: @manniefabian/59356)

Police issued an unusual alert about an armed suspect in the Kfar Kish area. A wide search is underway in an olive grove, involving police and border guards including the air unit. The public is urged to remain vigilant. (Source: @yediotnews25/136353)

Political tensions continue with Yaakov Gantz (48%) leading Benjamin Netanyahu (41%) in a recent survey for prime minister. A new poll shows Yesh Atid with 21 seats compared to Likud's 18. (Source: @yediotnews25/136351)

sections.threat_assessment: Cross-border tensions remain high with ongoing Lebanese army ordnance disposal operations suggesting recent conflict activity. The IDF continues targeted strikes in Gaza against Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives, indicating persistent militant activity. Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure, including Riyadh's airport, demonstrate expanding regional threat vectors. Car-ramming incidents in the West Bank signal continued asymmetric threats against Israeli civilians and security forces.
sections.regional_response: The Saudi coalition is actively responding to Houthi attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid airport, reporting 20 incidents this month. Lebanese military is conducting systematic unexploded ordnance disposal operations in border areas. Israeli security forces are maintaining heightened alert status following car-ramming incidents and ongoing Gaza operations. Regional actors are implementing countermeasures against shadow-banking networks targeting Iran's financial infrastructure.
sections.intelligence_notes: Recent Iranian missile test launches from Mianeh indicate continued ballistic capabilities development. Operation Economic Outcast reveals extensive Iranian shadow-banking networks spanning Iraq, Iran, and offshore jurisdictions. Political developments in Israel show Yaakov Gantz leading Netanyahu in prime ministerial preference polls. Cross-border incidents in Lebanon suggest ongoing low-level tensions requiring continued monitoring.
